an7.51:1.2: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti. evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca
an7.51:2.2: itthikuttaṃ itthākappaṃ itthividhaṃ itthicchandaṃ itthissaraṃ itthālaṅkāraṃ
an7.51:2.4: sā tattha rattā tatrābhiratā bahiddhā purisindriyaṃ manasikaroti
an7.51:2.5: purisakuttaṃ purisākappaṃ purisavidhaṃ purisacchandaṃ purisassaraṃ purisālaṅkāraṃ
an7.51:2.7: sā tattha rattā tatrābhiratā bahiddhā saññogaṃ ākaṅkhati
an7.51:2.8: yañcassā saññogapaccayā uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ tañca ākaṅkhati
an7.51:2.9: itthatte bhikkhave abhiratā sattā purisesu saññogaṃ gatā
an7.51:2.10: evaṃ kho bhikkhave itthī itthattaṃ nātivattati.
